description:
Because:

- fxa-shared folders move to Nx libs, and the NestJS health code was in packages/fxa-shared/nestjs.

This commit:

- Moves HealthModule, HEALTH_CONFIG and getVersionInfo to libs/shared/nest-health.
- Points admin-server and event-broker at @fxa/shared/nest-health.
- Deletes packages/fxa-shared/nestjs and its exports entry, and lets the fxa-shared jest block pass with no tests.
- Adds find-up to the root package.json and a version.spec.ts.

Closes FXA-14695
